231: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ; ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
They do not recognise the real aim of life; they only keep bundles of straw tied on their heads. ॥2॥
Those who follow their own minds, lacking acquaintance with God, stay on the wrong road of life.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
They forget the Name of God but hold firmly to many rites.
Caught in love of another, they stay drowned in the world-ocean. ॥3॥
Though thirsting after Maya, he still calls himself a pandit;
caught in attachment to Maya, he suffers much within.
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ; ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
The noose of spiritual death hangs around his neck, and spiritual death torments him always. ॥4॥
Spiritual death does not come near one who faces the Guru.
Through the Guru's word he burns away pride from within.
Dyed in the Name, he keeps singing God's virtues. ॥5॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ; ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Maya becomes the servant of those who worship God, and meets their needs.
Whoever falls at the feet of such devotees also finds a place at the Lord's feet.
He too becomes pure of mind for ever and rests in stillness of mind. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ; ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Those who hear the praises of God are seen as truly wealthy in the world.
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
All bow before them and honour them at all times,
ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
for, in stillness of mind, they keep the virtues of the eternal Lord in their hearts. ॥7॥
One to whom the perfect true Guru has recited the word of praise
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ; ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
has erased the hold of the three qualities and fixed his mind in the fourth state, beyond their reach.
O Nanak, the Guru has killed his pride and united him with God. ॥8॥4॥
The pandit reads the Veda he takes to be spoken by Brahma, and recites arguments from it,
but within him is darkness, for he does not examine his own spiritual life.
Only when one utters the Guru's word does one find God. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
I serve the Guru, and one who does so is never again consumed by spiritual death.
Those who follow their own minds are consumed through love of Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Even sinners, taking the Guru's refuge, make their lives fruitful.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
Through the Guru's word they settle within in stillness of mind.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
Longing for Him, they find my Lord; through the Guru's word their lives bear fruit. ॥2॥
Those whom the true Guru has joined to his word, God Himself has united with His feet.
ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
They become dear to the mind of my eternal Lord.
In stillness of mind and in love, they sing God's virtues. ॥3॥
Missing the Guru, the form of the eternal Lord, they go astray through wandering.
Those who follow their own minds, blinded by attachment, keep eating this poison,
ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
and so they suffer the punishment of spiritual death and are always in pain. ॥4॥
ਜਮੂਆ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
The wretched messenger of death cannot even look at one who stays in God's refuge.
Driving out pride, he keeps his attention on the eternal Lord.
ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
He keeps his attention ever fixed on the Name of God. ॥5॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Those who take the true Guru's refuge become pure and clean in life.
ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Joining their minds with the Guru's mind, they conquer the whole world.
ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
O my friend, in this way you too will have bliss within. ॥6॥
One who takes the true Guru's refuge obtains this fruit:
the Name dwells in his heart, and he drives out selfhood from within.
He makes the unbroken word of praise resound within him. ॥7॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ. ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
O my brother, who is there who does not succeed through the true Guru?
Through devotion people succeed in life and win honour at the Lord's door.
O Nanak, through the Lord's Name they win greatness everywhere. ॥8॥5॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who takes interest only in the play of the three qualities is not rid of wandering.
ਬੰਧਨ. ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
His bonds do not break, and he finds no release.
In the world, only the true Guru gives release from attachment to Maya. ॥1॥
One who takes the Guru's refuge drives out his wandering;
ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
a current of stillness rises within him, as he keeps his attention on God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ; ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Over the heads of those absorbed in the three qualities runs the command of spiritual death;
232: they never remember the Name of the Creator.
They die and are born again and again. ॥2॥
ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
From a guru who is himself blind, the disciple's wandering does not go.
Leaving the Root, the Creator, such followers cling to love of Maya.
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Drunk on poison, one stays absorbed in that very poison. ॥3॥
Making Maya their support, people keep wandering;
through love of Maya they forget God.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
One on whom God casts His glance of grace attains the highest spiritual state. ॥4॥
Within him the Guru reveals the eternal Lord, and outside, as he deals with the world, shows Him everywhere.
ਸਾਚੁ. ਨ ਛਪੈ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
Even if he tries to keep this gift hidden, the eternal Lord does not stay hidden.
Those deeply bound to God understand this, in stillness and in love. ॥5॥
One who takes the Guru's refuge keeps his attention on the eternal Lord;
through the Guru's word he burns away pride and attachment to Maya.
My eternal Lord keeps him united with Himself. ॥6॥
One to whom the true Guru, giver of the Name, recites his word,
guards his wandering mind, holds it back and keeps it in check.
From the perfect Guru he gains true understanding. ॥7॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
God Himself is the Creator, who made the world and Himself destroyed it.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Apart from Him there is no other.
O Nanak, a rare one who takes the Guru's refuge understands this. ॥8॥6॥
The priceless Name cannot be bought; one who takes the Guru's refuge obtains it.
He serves the Name alone, and through the Name rests in stillness of mind.
With his tongue he ever sings the Name that gives spiritual life.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
But only one on whom God Himself shows mercy enjoys the taste of the Name. ॥1॥
Night and day I repeat the Name of the Lord of the world in my heart.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By taking the Guru's refuge I have attained the highest state, and I enjoy bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Bliss abides in their hearts and light dawns within them
who, taking the Guru's refuge, sing of the eternal Lord, the treasure of virtues.
They remain for ever the servants of God's servants.
Living in household and family, they stay ever detached from Maya. ॥2॥
A rare one who takes the Guru's refuge is free of Maya's bonds while still at work in the world.
He alone obtains the Name, the highest of all things.
He erases the hold of the three qualities and becomes pure.
Staying in stillness, joined to the eternal Lord, he meets that Lord. ॥3॥
ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
That person no longer has the attached love for his family
in whose heart the eternal Lord has come to dwell.
One whose mind, through the Guru, is pierced by God's remembrance becomes steady;
he recognises God's will and understands that eternal Lord. ॥4॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
You alone are the Creator; I see no other support but You.
ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
I remember You alone, and from You alone comes my honour.
Only if You show mercy can I sing Your praises.
ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ; ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
Your Name is my jewel, and Your Name is the light in all the world. ॥5॥
One to whom, through the Guru, the word of praise tastes sweet,
his heart blossoms, and his attention stays fixed on the Lord night and day.
By the Guru's grace, through stillness of mind, he meets the eternal Lord.
But the true Guru is found only by full and great good fortune. ॥6॥
Pride, possessiveness, evil thinking and suffering are destroyed
when the Name of God, the treasure of virtues, comes to dwell in the heart.
Through the Guru, by hearing God's praise, one's understanding is made bright
when one remembers God in the heart and rests one's attention at His feet. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Only that person obtains the Name to whom God Himself gives it.
One whom God unites with Himself through the Guru drives out his selfhood.
He enshrines the eternal Name in his heart.
O Nanak, he rests in stillness of mind, absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥8॥7॥
ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ; ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
One who has made his mind beautiful from within, in awe of God, in stillness and in love,
233: has dyed his mind through the Guru's word, with his attention fixed on God.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
He dwells at the Lord's feet, content in the Lord's will. ॥1॥
By taking the true Guru's refuge, arrogance goes,
and God, the treasure of virtues, is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
When, through the word, a person makes awe of the indwelling Lord the food of his soul, his mind turns from Maya,
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
and he sees my pure Lord pervading everywhere.
By the Guru's grace, united by the Guru, he meets God. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
One who becomes a servant of God's servants enjoys spiritual bliss.
ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
In this way alone is my dear Lord found.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
By God's mercy he keeps singing God's virtues. ॥3॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
A long life is accursed if no love for God's Name is born through it.
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Accursed too is the comfortable bed of a beautiful woman, if it brings the pitch darkness of attachment.
ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ; ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Their birth alone bears fruit who have made the Name their support. ॥4॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Accursed, accursed is the household and family life through which no love for God is born.
ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਜੋ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
He alone is my friend who sings the virtues of that Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
Apart from God's Name I see no other lasting companion. ॥5॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ; ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
From the true Guru we attain the high spiritual state that brings honour.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Whoever has meditated on God's Name has rid himself of every pain.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Fixing his attention on God's Name, he enjoys bliss for ever. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਹਮ ਕਉ. ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
When the Guru is met, we gain the understanding to keep the body from vices.
In one who takes the Guru's refuge, the whole fire of pride and craving is quenched;
anger is destroyed, and he holds fast to forgiveness. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
God Himself shows mercy and gives His Name.
Only a rare one, through the Guru, takes hold of this jewel of the Name.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
Nanak ever sings the virtues of God, the unseen and unknowable. ॥8॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ; ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ. ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
Those who turn their faces from the true Guru look wretched, turned away from him.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Bound, they are struck by attachment night and day, and never again find the time to escape. ॥1॥
O Lord, O Lord, show mercy and save me.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O God, keep me in the company of the holy, so that I may cherish Your virtues in my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
Those devotees are dear to God who, through the Guru, live as the Guru teaches,
ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ; ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
who give up self and serve, and while at work in the world remain untouched by Maya. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
The Lord who gave this body and this life, His command alone runs over everyone.
ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ. ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Why forget Him from the mind? Keep God enshrined in the heart. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
If the Name is received, honour is found; if the mind is won over by the Name, there is spiritual bliss.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
The Name is received from the true Guru alone; by His grace that Lord is met. ॥4॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ, ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ; ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ. ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
Those who turn their faces from the true Guru keep wandering and never find peace.
ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਝਲਈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
Neither earth nor sky can bear them; lying in the filth of attachment, they burn away their spiritual life. ॥5॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ; ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Maya has led this world astray in wandering, feeding it the drug of attachment.
ਜਿਨਾ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Those who have met the true Guru, Maya does not even come near. ॥6॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Those who take refuge in the true Guru remove the filth of pride and come to live pure lives.
234: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Those dyed in the word become pure and walk as the true Guru wills. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
O Lord God, You alone are the Giver; in Your mercy, unite me with Yourself.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
Your servant Nanak has come to Your refuge; save me as it pleases You. ॥8॥1॥9॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, sojourner in a strange land, how may God be met, who cares for us like a mother?
ਗੁਰੁ. ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
One who by full good fortune finds the Guru, the Beloved comes and clasps him to His neck. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, unbridled as a young camel, keep in mind the true Guru, the form of God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, become thoughtful and meditate on God's Name.
ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
Where the account is demanded, God Himself will clear you. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, you were very pure, but the filth of pride has come to cling to you.
ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
The Husband Lord is plainly present in the heart, right beside the soul, yet parted from Him it suffers blows. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, search for God in your heart, search and search again.
ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਲਭਈ; ਗੁਰੁ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
He is not found by any other means; the Guru shows God dwelling in the heart. ॥4॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, fix your attention on God day and night.
ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ. ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
So you will reach the palace of bliss and find your place there; but only the Guru unites one with God. ॥5॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, you are my friend: give up hypocrisy and greed for Maya.
ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
The hypocrite and the greedy are spiritually killed; God punishes them with the dread of spiritual death. ॥6॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ; ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, cast off the filth of vices, hypocrisy and wandering.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
The perfect Guru has filled the pool of God's nectar Name to the brim; join the holy company, and your filth will be washed away. ॥7॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, listen to this one teaching of the Guru:
ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
this web of attachment to Maya is spread all around, and at the end none of it will go with you. ॥8॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, my friend, one who has taken God's Name as provision for the journey wins honour;
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
he is robed with honour in God's court, and God Himself clasps him to His neck. ॥9॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
O unbridled mind, with faith in the Guru, do the work the Guru teaches.
ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ. ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
O servant Nanak, pray before the Guru: keep me joined to God. ॥10॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, become thoughtful; reflect and look with care.
ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ; ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
O forest-dweller, weary of wandering the forests, behold the Lord in your heart through the Guru's teaching. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, unbridled as a young camel, keep God's remembrance treasured within you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, become thoughtful: those who follow their own minds are caught in the great net of Maya.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
One who takes the Guru's refuge is set free, cherishing the Name of God in his heart. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, go into the company of the holy and seek the true Guru there.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
In the company of the holy, one should meditate on God; the Name of God will go with you. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, that person becomes greatly fortunate on whom God casts a single glance of grace.
235: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
Only if God himself sets us free do we get out, holding the Guru's feet in the heart. ॥4॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O my dear unbridled mind, guard the divine light that dwells within your body.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
God's Name is the nine treasures; the one to whom the Guru shows it has received this gift from the merciful Lord. ॥5॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ; ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, you never stay still; give up this cleverness, which throws you into a dreadful pit.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ; ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
Keep the Lord's Name always in mind; the Lord alone frees you at the final hour. ॥6॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, guard the jewel of deep knowing of God, and become greatly fortunate.
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ. ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ; ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
The knowledge the Guru gives is a sword that slays death; whoever takes it in hand kills the dread of death with it. ॥7॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
The treasure is within you, O unbridled mind, yet you wander in delusion searching outside.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
One who meets the Guru, the image of God, finds the Lord, the friend, dwelling right beside him. ॥8॥
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind dyed in the colour of Maya, keep the colour of the Lord's love always within.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
The colour of the Lord's love never fades; so take the Guru's shelter and hold his word in your heart. ॥9॥
ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
O unbridled mind, we are birds, and the all-pervading, deathless Lord is the tree that shelters us.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
O servant Nanak, the fortunate reach that shelter by holding the Name in the heart through the Guru. ॥10॥2॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
When a person takes pride in his own mind,
then, crazed by it, he goes about estranged from everyone.
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ; ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
But when he became the dust of everyone's feet,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
then he saw the beautiful Lord in every body. ॥1॥
The fruit of humility is inner steadiness and ease;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
my Guru has given me this gift of a humble nature. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
As long as a person thinks everyone else bad,
so long it seems to him that all are laying snares for him.
But when he removed the sense of mine and yours from within,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
then he is sure that no one bears him any enmity. ॥2॥
As long as he kept only his own interest in mind,
ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ; ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
so long he remains in great difficulty.
But when he recognised the Creator dwelling everywhere,
ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
then no jealousy towards anyone is left in him. ॥3॥
As long as he keeps his attachment to the world firmly tied,
he keeps wandering, and spiritual death always has him in its sights.
ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
But when all the wanderings of his mind come to an end,
then no distance remains between him and the Supreme God. ॥4॥
ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
As long as he holds on to distinctions between himself and others,
ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ; ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
so long his soul goes on receiving the punishment of pain and distress.
But when he understood the one God alone to dwell everywhere,
ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
then every part of the right way of living becomes clear to him. ॥5॥
As long as he runs about as a dependant of Maya,
he is not satisfied, and his thirst for Maya does not end.
ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
When he draws apart from this attachment to Maya,
then Maya gets up and follows behind him as his servant. ॥6॥
When by his grace the Guru meets a person,
understanding dawns in his mind, as a lamp is lit in a house.
Then he grasps what winning and losing really are in human life,
ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
and then he learns the worth of this body. ॥7॥
236: God alone does everything and causes it to be done;
he himself gives understanding, and himself weighs and tests each life.
ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
He is far from no one; he is near all and with all.
O Nanak, the Lord is everlasting, the doer of all wonders, and he alone is worthy of praise. ॥8॥1॥
Only one who takes the Guru's shelter is joined to the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
The Guru meets the one on whose forehead good fortune awakens.
In that person's heart the Lord comes to dwell,
and his mind and body grow cool and unshaken by vice. ॥1॥
O my mind, keep singing such praise of God
ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ; ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
as serves you both in this life and in the next. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Repeating his Name, every kind of fear and every calamity goes,
and the mind that runs after vice comes back to its place.
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Repeating his Name, no pain can touch you again,
and repeating his Name, pride leaves from within. ॥2॥
Repeating his Name, the five vices come under control,
repeating his Name, the life-giving water of the Name is gathered in the heart.
Repeating his Name, the thirst for Maya is quenched,
and repeating his Name, one succeeds in the Lord's court as well. ॥3॥
Repeating his Name, millions of past sins are wiped out,
and repeating his Name, one becomes a good person from then on.
Repeating his Name, the mind grows cool,
and repeating his Name, one gets rid of all the filth within. ॥4॥
Repeating his Name, a person obtains the jewel of the Lord's Name,
ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
and grows so at one with the Lord that he never lets it go again.
Repeating his Name is like gaining a home in many heavens,
and repeating his Name, one finds joy and a dwelling in inner steadiness. ॥5॥
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
Repeating his Name, the fire of craving will not touch you,
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
repeating his Name, the dread of death will not come near you.
Repeating his Name, you will stand with a bright face everywhere,
and repeating his Name, every kind of pain will go. ॥6॥
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
Repeating his Name, no difficulty arises on life's journey,
and repeating his Name, one keeps hearing the unbroken music of inner joy.
Repeating his Name, one earns a spotless reputation,
and repeating his Name, the lotus of the heart turns upright towards God. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
The Guru has cast his very best glance of grace on that person
ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
in whose heart he plants the teaching of repeating the Lord's Name.
The unbroken praise of God becomes rich food for the soul
Says Nanak: of the one who has met the perfect Guru. ॥8॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
He sets the Guru's word within his heart,
breaks off his company with the five, lust and the rest,
brings all ten senses under his control,
and light dawns in his soul. ॥1॥
Such inner strength arises in the one
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
on whom that God has mercy and grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
The one to whom friend and foe seem just alike,
whatever he speaks, he speaks of spiritual understanding,
whatever he hears, he hears only God's praise,
and whatever he sees becomes a cause for fixing his attention on God. ॥2॥
Awake or asleep, he remains in inner steadiness;
whatever happens in God's will he accepts as right, and stays in that steadiness.
In sorrow or in gladness he remains in inner steadiness;
silent or speaking, he is in that steadiness. ॥3॥
In inner steadiness he eats, and in inner steadiness he deals lovingly with others;
through inner steadiness all deceit is wiped out of him;
in inner steadiness he comes to meet the Guru,
At home he is in inner steadiness, and withdrawn from the world he is in it too;
237: through inner steadiness the sense of mine and yours leaves his heart.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ; ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
The one in whose mind joy arises through inner steadiness
meets God, the master of the highest bliss. ॥5॥
Settled in inner steadiness he keeps drinking the nectar of the Name,
and through that steadiness he gives others the gift of spiritual life;
his soul is steeped in talk of God's praise, which brings inner steadiness,
and the imperishable Lord comes to dwell in his heart. ॥6॥
In inner steadiness his seat stays firm, and that seat pleases him;
in inner steadiness he keeps the unbroken word of praise sounding strongly within;
through inner steadiness a sweet, unbroken current of joy runs within him.
In his heart God is always manifest. ॥7॥
One on whom God's grace falls settles in inner steadiness;
he meets the Guru, and makes remembrance of the everlasting Name his duty.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Only the one in whom this steadiness arises knows what it is;
servant Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ॥8॥3॥
First a creature gets free of its stay in the mother's womb,
then is caught up in attachment to sons, wife and family,
eats food of many kinds and wears many clothes,
yet such people too will surely depart, like orphans. ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ; ਜੋ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
Which is the place that never passes away?
ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Which is the word by which evil thinking is removed? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Even in Indra's realm death is sure to come;
Brahma's realm too cannot stay for ever;
Shiva's realm also will be destroyed.
Under Maya of the three qualities the world strays from the right path and keeps courting spiritual death. ॥2॥
ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ; ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Mountains, trees, earth, sky and stars,
sun, moon, wind, fire and water,
day and night, fasts and all the various observances,
the Shastras, the Smritis and the Vedas, will all perish in the end. ॥3॥
Places of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books,
rosaries, forehead marks, ritually pure kitchens and those who offer fire sacrifices,
the yogic dhoti cleansing, prostrations, and on the other side the pleasures of palaces,
Castes and the four classes, Muslims and Hindus,
beasts, birds and the creatures of countless species,
this whole spread of the world that is seen,
all this visible creation will perish. ॥5॥
Where there is praise that brings inner steadiness, devotion, and deep knowing of God, the source of all,
that place is everlasting and unshaken, and there is always joy there.
There the company of the holy relishes God's virtues;
there a city stands for ever which no fear can reach. ॥6॥
ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ; ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
There no fear, delusion, sorrow or worry can reach;
the round of birth and death is no more there, nor is there spiritual death.
There the arenas of unbroken joy are always in session,
and there the devotees live by the support of God's praise. ॥7॥
The Supreme God's qualities have no end and no farther shore;
there is no one who can think of finding their limit.
Says Nanak: the one on whom God has mercy
gains the unshaken place, the company of the holy, and there crosses over. ॥8॥4॥
One who kills this sense of mine and yours is the real hero;
one who kills it is the possessor of all virtues.
One who kills it is honoured everywhere;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
one who kills it is freed of every pain. ॥1॥
ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ; ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Rare is the person who kills the sense of mine and yours within and casts it out;
ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ; ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
having killed it, he practises union with God while living as a householder. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
238: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
One who kills it is touched by no fear;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
those who kill it are absorbed in the Name.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
One who kills it has his craving for Maya quenched;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
one who kills it succeeds in the Lord's court. ॥2॥
One who kills it becomes rich in the wealth of the Name;
one who kills it becomes a person of honour;
one who kills it is the real celibate;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
one who kills it attains the high spiritual state. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
One who kills it is counted as having come into the world to good purpose;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
one who kills it stays unshaken by Maya's assaults and is the truly wealthy one.
One who kills it is greatly fortunate;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
one who kills it stays alert at all hours against Maya's assaults. ॥4॥
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
One who kills it stays free of vice while carrying on the world's work;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
one who kills it has a pure way of living.
One who kills it has deep knowing of God;
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
one who kills it stays settled in inner steadiness. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
Without killing it no one is accepted in God's sight,
though he perform millions of rites, recitations and austerities.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
Without killing it the round of births does not end;
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਮ ਤੇ. ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
without killing it there is no release from the messengers of death. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without killing it no deep knowing of God arises;
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
without killing it the filth of vice is not washed from the mind.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
Without killing it, whatever a person does only makes the mind fouler,
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
and without killing it he keeps himself at a distance from God. ॥7॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
The one to whom God, the treasure of mercy, is merciful
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ; ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
is released from it and gains complete success in life.
ਗੁਰਿ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
The one whose sense of mine and yours the Guru has destroyed,
Says Nanak: he becomes fit to reflect on God's virtues. ॥8॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
When a person joins himself to the Lord in love, everyone appears to him a friend;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
when he is joined to the Lord, his mind stays unshaken.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
When he is joined to the Lord, no worry can get a hold on him;
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
when he is joined to the Lord, he is carried across. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
O my mind, fix your love on the Lord;
no other effort will be of any use to you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who are great owners of worldly property,
the fools, find none of it any use to them.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
Though the Lord's servant be born in a low family, people listen to him,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
and in his company they are saved in a moment. ॥2॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Hearing his Name holds millions of pilgrimage baths;
ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
fixing the attention on him holds millions of acts of worship;
ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ; ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
hearing the word of the Lord's praise holds millions of good deeds;
ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
learning from the Guru the way to meet him yields all these millions of fruits. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
Remember God in your mind always,
and all your attachments to Maya will perish.
The imperishable Lord dwells always with you;
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
O my mind, stay steeped in the colour of his love. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
By engaging in his service all hunger for Maya goes;
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
by engaging in his service the messengers of death cannot even look at you;
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
by engaging in his service you can gain great glory;
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
by engaging in his service you can gain unending spiritual life. ॥5॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
He whose servant no suffering can touch,
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
whose servant no bad habit can cling to,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ; ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
in whose office no account is asked of the servant,
serve that God with special care. ॥6॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
He in whose house nothing is lacking,
who, being the One himself alone, appears in countless forms,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
by whose glance of grace every creature is made glad,
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
O my mind, labour in his service. ॥7॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
No one becomes wise by himself, and no one stays a fool by his own choice;
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
no one is weak and no one a hero of himself.
239: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Each is engaged in whatever God has set him to.
O Nanak, he alone becomes God's servant whose fortune awakens. ॥8॥6॥
Without remembrance, life is like the long life of a snake;
so do those cut off from God live, having forgotten the Name. ॥1॥
ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ; ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
Even the blink of an eye spent in remembrance of God
ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ; ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
is as good as millions of days lived, for it makes the life of the spirit steady for ever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without remembrance, all other deeds are accursed;
like a crow's beak, such mouths stay in filth. ॥2॥
Without remembrance, people take to the ways of dogs;
those cut off from God become shameless like a prostitute's sons, whose father cannot be named. ॥3॥
Without remembrance, they are a burden, like the horns on a ram's head;
those cut off from God speak lies and earn disgrace everywhere. ॥4॥
Without remembrance, they live as foully as a donkey;
those cut off from God keep roaming in filthy places. ॥5॥
Without remembrance, they become like mad dogs;
those cut off from God are gripped by greed, and nothing can restrain them. ॥6॥
Without remembrance, a person brings spiritual death on himself;
ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
one cut off from God leans towards low deeds, and neither high family nor high caste remains his. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
The one to whom God becomes merciful he brings into the company of the holy.
Says Nanak: in this way he carries the world across through the Guru. ॥8॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੋਹਿ. ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Walking by the Guru's teaching I have reached the highest spiritual state;
the perfect Guru has kept my honour safe. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching I have remembered the Lord's Name,
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and by the Guru's grace I have found a place at God's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Hearing God's praise through the Guru's teaching, I keep uttering it with my tongue;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
by the Guru's grace the life-giving word of praise has become my own wealth. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching my self-conceit has been wiped out;
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
by the Guru's mercy I have gained great glory. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Walking by the Guru's teaching, the wandering of my mind is gone,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
and through the Guru's teaching I have seen God dwelling everywhere. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching I enjoy union with God while living as a householder;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
in the Guru's company the whole world crosses over. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Walking by the Guru's teaching, I meet success in all my tasks;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
through the Guru's teaching I have gained the Name, the treasure. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Whoever has placed his hope in my Guru
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
has had the noose of death cut away. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching my fortune has awakened;
O Nanak, I have met the Guru, and by his grace I have met the Supreme God. ॥8॥8॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
With every breath I remember that Guru
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who is the support of my life and the guardian of my spiritual capital. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
As I behold the Guru again and again, I gain spiritual life;
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
as I wash the Guru's feet again and again, I receive the water of the Name to drink. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ; ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
I bathe always in the dust of the Guru's feet,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
and remove from my mind the filth of pride gathered over many births. ॥2॥
I wave the fan over that Guru
ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ; ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
who has given his hand and saved me from the great fire of vice. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
I carry water for the household of that Guru
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
from whom I have learned to understand the God who never wanes or grows. ॥4॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
I grind corn always in the household of that Guru
by whose grace those who seemed enemies all now appear as friends. ॥5॥
240: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru who has given me spiritual life,
who has himself bought me and made me his humble servant, ॥6॥
who has himself kindled his love within me,
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
to that Guru I bow for ever and ever. ॥7॥
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ; ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
In his refuge my strife, troubles, fears, wandering and sorrows have gone.
Says Nanak: my Guru has great power. ॥8॥9॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Meet me, O my Gobind, and give me Your Name.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, every other love is accursed, accursed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Whatever a person wears and eats without remembering the Name
is like a dog putting its mouth into foul leavings. ॥1॥
All the business a person does while forgetting the Name
is as useless as adorning a corpse. ॥2॥
One who forgets the Name and goes on enjoying worldly things
ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ; ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
finds no comfort in them even in a dream, and disease grows in his body. ॥3॥
One who gives up the Name and busies himself with other work
ruins his spiritual life, and all his outward shows come to nothing. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
One who does not attach his mind in love to the Name
lands in hell even while performing millions of ritual deeds. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਮਨਿ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥
One who has not remembered the Lord's Name in his mind
ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੬॥
stays bound in the city of Death, like a thief. ॥6॥
Hundreds of thousands of displays and all the many extensions,
without the Name, are all a useless spread. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Only that person remembers the Lord's Name
to whom, O Nanak, God in His grace gives it. ॥8॥10॥
The One who stands by a person at all times, beginning, middle and end,
that Friend my mind longs to meet. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Love joined to the Lord always keeps a person company.
The merciful, all-pervading Lord, complete in every virtue, always cherishes His servant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He never dies, and He never leaves anyone and goes away.
Wherever I look, there He is present. ॥2॥
God is beautiful, skilful, wise, the giver of life;
He is our real brother, son, father and mother. ॥3॥
He is the support of my life and breath, the capital of my spiritual life.
I have set Him in my heart and joined my love to Him. ॥4॥
The Protector of creation has cut my noose of Maya.
Looking on me with a glance of grace, He has made me His own. ॥5॥
By remembering Him again and again all diseases can be cut away.
Fixing the mind on His feet is itself every comfort and every enjoyment. ॥6॥
The all-pervading Lord has every virtue; He is ever new, ever young.
The Lord dwells within each being and everywhere outside, is with all and protects all. ॥7॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨ ॥
Says Nanak: he comes to understand the state of union with the Lord
to whom, as His devotee, God gives the Name, which is his entire wealth. ॥8॥11॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸੰਖ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Countless beings have gone about searching, but none has found the limit of God's qualities.
Only those on whom His grace falls can become His devotees. ॥1॥
I give myself up, I give myself up to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਡਰਾਉ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੈਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Hearing again and again that the road of life is fearful, I was greatly afraid;
ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਾਹ; ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
at last I have looked to the shelter of the saints: save me. ॥2॥
